description: Source code for serializing quantized linear layer weights in PyTorch, including support for FBGEMM and QNNPACK backends, with functions to wrap vectors into tensors and pack sparse matrix data.

classes.name: BCSR
classes.description: Sparse matrix in Compressed Sparse Row format used for weight packing.

classes.name: BCSRSerializationType
classes.description: Data structure for serialized sparse matrix weights and related parameters.

methods.name: wrap_vector
methods.description: Wraps a vector-like data structure into a PyTorch tensor, copying data.

methods.name: pack_bcsr
methods.description: Packs a dense matrix into BCSR sparse format, optionally considering zero points.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeight::serialize
methods.description: Serializes packed linear weight data, including sparse matrix packing and quantization parameters.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeightQnnp::serialize
